sequence: store A and store B load the same durable empty generation
A begin_call(child-A, call-A) durably publishes inflight A
B, still holding its stale empty in-memory snapshot, begin_call(child-B, call-B)
B atomically replaces the canonical file with a snapshot containing only B
reproduction.impact: a restart/overlap can forget a pre-side-effect inflight marker; the same logical mutating delegated task can later look replayable

candidate_contract.required: serialize the whole read-modify-write transaction across processes and refresh canonical state while holding the lock
not_sufficient: asyncio/thread lock confined to one process
candidate_contract.windows: UNPROVEN: final lock primitive must pass native Windows before integration
